products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare technology company that provides data, analytics, and software products to health systems, life sciences organizations, and government health programs. The company describes itself as offering trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. Its portfolio spans clinical decision support, imaging, cardiovascular data management, clinical trial management, real-world evidence, and health data analytics.

Among its named products, Micromedex delivers clinical decision support at the point of care and is described by a customer as an industry leader of forty years standing. Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo form a cloud-based enterprise imaging and cardiovascular suite, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo noted as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Zelta is a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform for clinical trials, and Truven provides health data and analytics with consulting services for business decision-making. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the site include a jump from 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort.

The site's held facts identify Merative as formerly Watson Health, reflecting its origin as IBM's healthcare data and analytics division. Its tracked product covers healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded in the available data.
